bullets: Pre- and post-deployment verification for release readiness across dev, staging and production-related environments.
Validated CI/CD runs and deployments to Red Hat OpenShift using Atlassian Bamboo.
Reviewed Helm charts, environment variables and ConfigMaps to catch configuration inconsistencies.
Database deployment checks: SQL schema migrations, piloting vs production consistency and rollback validation.
Reviewed deployment SOPs and release plans in Jira and Confluence; worked with Dev, Ops and Platform teams to unblock releases.
Managed Linux servers, Docker containers, CI/CD pipelines and deployments.
Monitored infrastructure and apps with Prometheus and Grafana.
Configured Nginx reverse proxy, SSL certificates and domain routing.
Implemented security scanning with Trivy and SonarQube.
Created solution designs and presented API Gateway solutions.
Gathered integration and validation requirements and ensured they were delivered as agreed with the customer.
Weekly and monthly health-check reports and preventive maintenance for the Kong API environment.
Kept IT operations running: hardware and software assets, troubleshooting, server backups and updates.
Coordinated with vendors and built the company profile website and desktop software.
Installed and repaired devices, cabling, operating systems and software for staff.
